name: Yampa River — Hayden (Yampa River State Park)
gaugeName: Yampa River above Elkhead Creek near Hayden, CO (USGS 09244490)
blurb: Gentle Yampa River State Park sections between Hayden and Craig, through private ranch land — stay off private banks.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Passes private property — CPW warns river bottom/shoreline use on private land is trespass. Mileage: CPW Yampa River State Park river sections. CPW low-water advisory posted for Yampa River State Park (as of 6-23-2026); check CPW before launching.
